01

“We created you, then We shaped you”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 7:11).

279
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās No. 279: 1: 2

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
279: 1:2. Sufyan, from al-Amash, from al-Minhal ibn Amr, from Ibn Abbas:
"We created you, then We shaped you": He said, We created you in the loins of men, then We shaped you in the wombs of women (verse 11).
العربية
279: 1: 2 سفيان عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنِ الْمِنْهَالِ بْنِ عمرو عن بن عَبَّاسٍ وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَاكُمْ ثُمَّ صَوَّرْنَاكُمْ قَالَ خَلَقْنَاكُمْ فِي أَصْلابِ الرِّجَالِ ثُمَّ صَوَّرْنَاكُمْ فِي أَرْحَامِ النِّسَاءِ (الآية 11) .
Edition record 371350 · p. 111Link to report ↗
02

“Then I will come at them from before them”

An explanation transmitted from Ibrāhīm (Q 7:17).

280
Explanation from Ibrāhīm No. 280: 2: 1

Ibrāhīm

English
Transmission wording
280: 2:1. Abu Hudhayfa related to us; Sufyan related to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim:
"Then I will come at them from before them": He said, from the side of their worldly life; "and from behind them": he said, from the side of their Hereafter; "and from their right": from the side of their good deeds; "and from their left": from the side of their evil deeds (verse 17).
العربية
280: 2: 1 حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حُذَيْفَةَ ثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ثُمَّ لآتينهم من بين أيديهم قَالَ مِنْ قِبَلِ دُنْيَاهُمْ وَمِنْ خلفهم قَالَ مِنْ قِبَلِ آخِرَتِهِمْ وَعَنْ أيمانهم من قبل حسناتهم وعن شمايلهم من قبل سيئاتهم (الآية 17) .
Edition record 371350 · p. 111Link to report ↗

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English

“clothing to cover your nakedness, and adornment, and the clothing of…”

An explanation transmitted from Sufyān al-Thawrī (Q 7:26).

283
Explanation from Sufyān No. 283: 5: 11

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
283: 5:11. Sufyan, on the words of God

06

“As He began you, you will return”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Jabir ibn Abd Allah (Q 7:29).

284
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 284: 6: 5

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
284: 6:5. Sufyan, from Waqa ibn Iyas, from Mujahid:
"As He began you, you will return": He said, the believer is resurrected a believer and the disbeliever a disbeliever (verse 29).
العربية
284: 6: 5 سفيان عن وقاء ابن بِنْ إِيَاسٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ كَمَا بدأكم تعودون قَالَ يُبْعَثُ الْمُؤْمِنُ مُؤْمِنًا وَالْكَافِرُ كافرا (الآية 29) .
Edition record 371351 · p. 112Link to report ↗
285
Report from Jabir ibn Abd Allah No. 285: 7: 6

Jabir ibn Abd Allah

English
Transmission wording
285: 7:6. Sufyan, from al-Amash, from Abu Sufyan, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, who said:
The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: Every servant will be resurrected in the state in which he died: the believer in his faith and the disbeliever in his disbelief.
العربية
285: 7: 6 سفيان عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُبْعَثُ كُلُّ عَبْدٍ عَلَى مَا مَاتَ عَلَيْهِ الْمُؤْمِنُ عَلَى إِيمَانِهِ وَالْكَافِرُ عَلَى كفره

Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās No. 286: 8: 12

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
286: 8:12. Sufyan, from Layth, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas, on the words of God

Edition record 371351 · p. 112Link to report ↗

Report from Ibn ʿAbbās No. 287: 9: 13

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
287: 9:13. Sufyan said: Ibn Abbas said,
"until the camel passes through the eye of the needle": He said, the ropes of the ship through the hole of the needle.

287: 9: 13 سفيان قال قال بن عَبَّاسٍ حَتَّى يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِي سم الخياط قال حبال السفيانة في ثقب الإبرة

08

“Pour upon us some water”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 7:50).

288
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās No. 288: 10: 7

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
288: 10:7. Sufyan, from Uthman ibn Abi Zura al-Thaqafi, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas:
"Pour upon us some water": He said, a man will call out to someone he knew among the people of Paradise, "Help me, so-and-so, for I am burning." And God, exalted be His mention, will say, "God has forbidden both to the disbelievers" (verse 50).
العربية
288: 10: 7 سفيان عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ الثَّقَفِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عن بن عَبَّاسٍ أَنْ أَفِيضُوا عَلَيْنَا مِنَ الماء قَالَ يُنَادِي الرَّجُلُ مَعْرِفَتَهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ أَنْ أَغِثْنِي يَا فلان فقد احْتَرَقْتُ فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ذِكْرُهُ: إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَهُمَا عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ (الآية 50) .
Edition record 371352 · p. 113Link to report ↗

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
